children: KLX Energy Services updated 3Q26 revenue guidance to $180 million–$185 million and expects Adjusted EBITDA margin of 13%–14%.
Revised 3Q26 revenue range to $180M–$185M, a ~9% sequential increase versus 2Q26.
Projects 3Q26 Adjusted EBITDA margin of 13%–14%, ~200 bps sequential margin improvement.
Expect Adjusted EBITDA to improve ~30% at the midpoint of guidance compared with 2Q26.
Notes a full-quarter contribution from the Wolf Pack acquisition and $2.5M annual synergy target on track.
Preliminary rights offering raised $37.2M gross; ~24.98M shares to be issued and ~$6.2M used to redeem 2030 Notes.
